[SCENE_CONTEXT]
Late autumn, early 1990s, a rural bus stop at dusk. An old man sits on the shelter bench with a heavy leather bag on his lap. His granddaughter reads the timetable sign, turns and tells him the last bus has gone. He says nothing and looks down at the bag.
